local.marker: uses pinned SAL tables for Windows-1250 through 1258 code pages

preservedResponsibilities: Native best-Windows-charset query over all88 metadata records with full locales enabled. The pinned97slot table plus five core dispatches are extracted and independently checkable; original absent-data default1 and unsigned16 input binding are retained. Only the consumed metadata field is bound; no fake converter/data lookup service or native shared-library loader is constructed. Locale-disabled builds and other tencinfo/converter metadata remain unverified.
Complete pinned Windows code-page to rtl_TextEncoding switch and unknown fallback.

The source size-gated field writes and unknown-encoding fallback use min/max/average character sizes and flags captured from pinned ImplTextEncodingData for all 55 represented single-byte converters plus UTF-8. The CONTEXT/ASCII choice used by Calc CSV export therefore follows the native metadata rather than a guessed encoding category.
omittedResponsibilities: Full native framework/ABI and complete format orchestration are not certified; see admission.
Other encoding families and complete SAL conversion factories remain outside the current Writer filter slice.
Metadata for unrepresented multi-byte/contextual converters and unrelated tencinfo queries remains outside this runtime slice.
